detail.longDescription: We built Hyper Elements. A open source content engine for agents. It lets them build emails, PDFs or images in React using much fewer tokens. The agent writes content, our engine handles the layout and markup. It also tells the agent what the problems are in the content and how to fix them. We tested it by giving Claude Code a brief and run it 5 times with different libraries like Hyper Elements, React Email and MJML. Each run, Hyper Elements used fewer tokens and produced a passing email much faster. The benchmark is also open source in the repo.
